questions.question: While Babylon's army attacked Jerusalem, who did the LORD send the prophet Jeremiah to speak to?
Through the prophet Jeremiah, what did the LORD say the king of Babylon would do to Jerusalem?
After the people of Jerusalem freed their Hebrew servants, how long did that freedom last?

answers.text: Until the people changed their minds
For the rest of their lives

questions.question: How did the people of Jerusalem seal their covenant before the LORD to free their servants?

answers.text: By passing between the pieces of a calf
By writing it down on a scroll
By setting up a pillar of stone
